zupix: Read and Write 'PNG', 'JPEG', 'WebP' and 'QOI' Images

Source: R/zupix-package.R
zupix-package.Rd

Decodes and encodes 'PNG', 'JPEG', 'WebP' and 'QOI' images with every codec compiled into the package, so installing it needs no system image library. Images decode to a native raster or to an integer or double array at 8 or 16 bits, and encode from the same shapes. Headers and metadata, including 'ICC' profiles and 'EXIF' orientation, are read without decoding pixels, and every size an image declares is checked before memory is allocated. The codecs are also available to other packages' C code through a registered function table.
